attacked.target: The valuation method is determined by Rule 206, which specifies the telegraphic transfer buying rate on the last day of the tax year (31 March 2027) for income from other sources.
attacked.attack: Rule 206 specifies that the telegraphic transfer buying rate should be used as of the 'specified date.' For 'Income from other sources,' the specified date is the last day of the tax year. However, the conclusion incorrectly applies the rate from the last day of the tax year (31 March 2027) instead of the date of credit (28 June 2026), which is the actual date when the income was recognized.
attacked.evidence: Rule 206(2)(b)(i) states that the specified date for 'Income from other sources' is the last day of the tax year, but the income was recognized on 28 June 2026, not 31 March 2027.
